user.title: Meal Manager
user.description: Plans meals with a local model through AI Task (e.g. Ollama). Configure portions, effort, calories, health level and meals per day afterwards under Configure.

data_description.ai_task_entity: Generates every dish and the shopping list, e.g. a local Ollama model. Empty = the preferred AI Task entity (Settings → System → General).
data_description.preferences: Free text sent to the AI Task entity: diet, dislikes, cuisines, equipment.
data_description.shopping_list: To-do list that receives the ingredients.
data_description.avoid_recent: Number of most recently cooked dishes to avoid in new plans.
data_description.season: Central Europe. Only in season: the model must use fresh produce that is in season now (e.g. no asparagus in October). Prefer: it should.
data_description.pantry: Told to the model, which leaves these out of the shopping list.

defaults.title: Default settings
defaults.description: Each setting can be a fixed value, an entity, or both (the value is then the fallback). Empty = built-in default (2 portions, medium effort, health 3, no calorie target).

slots.description: Untick meals you never want planned. Meals per day limits the number further (it can come from an entity and be overridden per weekday); then the enabled meals with the lowest priority number are kept. For one meal a day, either untick all but one meal or set meals per day to 1.

add_override.title: Override
add_override.description: Overrides beat the defaults. Order: weekday + meal > meal > weekday > default. Calories and meals per day can only be overridden per weekday.

not_loaded.message: Meal Manager is not set up.

invalid_days.message: A plan can cover 1 to {max} days.

no_recipe.message: The AI Task model gave no usable recipe for {slot} on {day}. Check the AI Task entity and the log.

no_plan.message: There is no active meal plan.

not_active.message: Only meals of the active plan can be marked as cooked. Accept the suggestion first.

title_required.message: A meal or a dish title is needed.

shopping_failed.message: The AI Task model gave no usable shopping list. Check the AI Task entity and the log.

generate_plan.name: Generate plan
generate_plan.description: Creates a new plan suggestion (draft) that can be reviewed and accepted.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First day of the plan. Default: today, or the day after the active plan.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days. Default: the configured days per plan.

accept_plan.name: Accept plan
accept_plan.description: Makes the plan suggestion the active plan.

mark_cooked.name: Mark cooked
mark_cooked.description: Marks a meal as cooked. When every meal is cooked a new plan is suggested.

slot.name: Meal
slot.description: Meal of the day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack), instead of a meal ID.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day of the meal when using a meal of the day. Default: today.

decline_meal.name: Decline meal
decline_meal.description: Replaces a meal with another suggestion.

ban_meal.name: Ban meal
ban_meal.description: Never suggests a dish again and replaces it in the plans.

title.name: Title
title.description: Title of the dish, instead of a meal ID.

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Adds the aggregated ingredients of all uncooked meals to a to-do list and returns them.

draft.name: Use suggestion
draft.description: Use the plan suggestion instead of the active plan.
